component.name: Vocalinux
component.summary: Free, offline voice dictation for Linux

description.p: Vocalinux is a privacy-first, fully offline voice dictation system for Linux. Speak naturally and your words appear in any application — on X11 or Wayland — using local speech recognition. No cloud, no data leaves your machine. Speech recognition models are downloaded on first run.

ul.li: Universal compatibility across all Linux applications
100% offline operation for privacy and reliability
whisper.cpp by default — high-performance C++ speech recognition
Universal GPU support via Vulkan (AMD, Intel, NVIDIA)
System tray integration with visual status indicators
Start on login support via XDG autostart
Pleasant audio feedback with smooth gliding tones
Graphical settings dialog for easy configuration

description.p: This Flatpak ships the whisper.cpp engine. On a Wayland session, text is injected through XWayland.

In-app update checker with tray notifications, hold Right Alt push-to-talk default for new installs, searchable language list, delete unused downloaded speech models, family dictation tone picker (default Voca, family preview WAVs), Settings About page for this app, VocaHQ, and talk to us, AGPL-3.0 relicensing, shared Voca family mic for app/tray/site icons, hardened installer with Justfile and uv lockfiles (distro python3-gi required), Test Dictation missing-model message, and desktop reliability fixes for IBus, audio capture, clipboard restore, GPU/Vulkan selection, and AppImage GI typelibs.

Searchable sidebar settings with dictation controls in the sidebar footer, AppImage packages for x86_64 and aarch64, expanded speech-language catalog (including Hungarian), sentence capitalization and trailing spaces for continuous dictation, auto-pause and idle model unload, Vulkan discrete-GPU selection, ibus-wayland support on previously unbridged compositors, Bluetooth mic capture crash fix, custom-shortcut Record/Set restore, and desktop reliability fixes.
IBus stability (engine process launch after XDG path import; first-dictation FocusIn gate on GNOME Wayland) and settings dialog tabs that scroll so the window fits the monitor.
First Flathub-oriented packaging release: Flatpak with whisper.cpp + Vulkan, wl-copy/ydotool Wayland paste, evdev global hotkeys, AUR package, layout-aware shortcuts, and installer fixes.
Vocalinux 0.14.0-beta as Flatpak: whisper.cpp with Vulkan, XDG config/models/logs, XWayland text injection, and system tray integration.
First Flatpak release: whisper.cpp engine with Vulkan GPU support, XDG-compliant data paths, and XWayland text injection.
Guided whisper.cpp model variants, hotplug keyboard rescanning, and IBus setup refinements.
Non-ASCII text injection, IBus Wayland detection fixes, Pop!_OS dependency support, and code quality improvements.
